selection_bias_findings.technical_explanation: For A_FROZEN_BASELINE_OFF and C_V1792_STRUCTURAL_SL_ON (which use BASELINE_FROZEN nearest M1/M5 target), target_distance >= $11.00 USD is a strict mathematical superset of net_rr >= 2.0 (0 missed eligible decisions outside Stage-1 candidates). For D3_TP_POLICY_ONLY and D4_STRUCTURE_PLUS_TP (which search farther M15/H1/H4/D1 pools when the nearest pool fails net_rr >= 2.0), non-Stage-1 checkpoints can also become ELIGIBLE by selecting a distant HTF pool (~$28-$32 away), and exhibit the same negative expectancy on the unbiased control sample.

stage1_filter_condition: target_distance >= 11.0 USD (mathematical superset of net_rr >= 2.0 at XAUUSDT ~$4,000)
